news.title: ASX gains after Wall Street rallies on falling oil prices; tech stocks jump

news.title: Qantas mulls offshoring up to 1000 jobs to India in AI deal
news.snippet: The airline is considering shifting jobs in marketing, finance, human resources and other back-office positions as part of a deal with consulting giant Accenture.

news.title: Critica slashes key cost at WA flagship rare earths project
news.snippet: Critica Ltd has cut sulphuric acid consumption by approximately 30 per cent at its Jupiter rare earths project in WA, strengthening the economics ahead of an upcoming scoping study.

news.title: The real reason Trump just rushed to help Japan
news.snippet: Tactless as ever, Donald Trump invoked the attack on Pearl Harbour as the US jumped in to help boost Japan’s currency. What’s more compelling is why America made the move.

news.title: ‘We let you down’: The child prodigy at the centre of a $28 billion Wall Street fire sale

news.title: Amplia teams up with big pharma for lung cancer trial
news.snippet: Amplia Therapeutics and pharmaceutical giant Eli Lilly are teaming up to trial a combination their respective drug therapies for non-small cell lung cancer.
